description: In the Work In Progress report the Last Activity column is left-aligned. Every other column in that group is right-aligned — Days Open, Labor Earned, Labor Remaining, Parts Earned, Parts Remaining, Earned, Remaining, Inv. Hrs and Total. Last Activity is the only one that is not.
env: Environment: QA branch sv8582 (https://sv8582.qa.shopview.com), build v3.5-f77875c. Desktop browser, signed in as an Admin.
steps: Open Reports, then Work In Progress, with the date range Last 12 Months and both locations, Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and Staging Lethbridge - 4310 selected.
Open Column Selection and switch Last Activity on.
Look at where the heading and the values sit in that column, and compare with the Days Open column beside it.
current:
The Last Activity heading and its values sit on the left of the column, while every other column in that group sits on the right.

The dates themselves are right — Today, then a number of days ago, then a dash when there is no activity. It is the alignment only.
expected: Last Activity is right-aligned, like every column that is not named in the left-aligned list.
source: WO #, Status, Customer, Asset, VIN, Location, and Advisor are left-aligned; every other column is right-aligned.
Last Activity is not in that left-aligned list, so it falls under "every other column".
